data.title: Corridor, after stand-up
data.transcript: Speaker 1: I need to tell someone. My visa expired in August and the renewal was refused, so I'm here without status while my lawyer appeals. Please don't say anything to HR. Speaker 2: I won't. That must be frightening. Speaker 1: It is. For the appeal I need a reference letter about my work. Speaker 2: I'll send you a reference letter by Friday. Speaker 1: Thank you.
